subject: Real-scene camera check with the owner (kernel r44, libcamera r2)
method: Owner held the phone upright in a room at night; one settled soft-ISP viewfinder frame per camera, rotated 90 degrees clockwise (DT rotation 270), viewed locally and deleted; then raw dark frames with both lenses covered
orientation: Both images upright after the rotation correction and not mirrored (confirms the 2026-11-02 rotation result)
front_imx132: Desk scene: recognisable, neutral colour, dim
rear_imx179_full_resolution: Bookshelf scene: very dark (channel means 11-18/255) with a green cast; at normal brightness the same camera balanced to R 103 G 104 B 95 earlier
black_level: Raw dark frames: front R 64 Gr 65 Gb 65 B 65, rear R 64 Gr 64 Gb 64 B 64 - matches the 64 (10-bit) configured in the libcamera IMX132/IMX179 helpers
conclusion: Drivers, Bayer order, black level and orientation are correct. Low-light quality is limited by libcamera's simple soft ISP: auto-exposure stops at one frame time and maximum analogue gain, and grey-world white balance has little signal in very dark scenes (no tuned colour matrix)
note: libcamera camera indices are not stable between boots; select cameras by name ('Internal back/front camera')
open: longer exposure in low light (frame-duration control in the soft ISP AGC)
